Preserve the mobile Aliens (1986) Queen as one towering eyeless royal with a huge swept-back layered fan crown and paired lobes, narrow neck and waist, ribbed torso, exactly four arms (two large outer arms plus two much smaller chest arms), two powerful digitigrade legs and one long continuous segmented spear-tail; no ovipositor on this combat profile. designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 mobile Queen: enormous swept-back layered fan crown with paired lobes, narrow neck and waist, two large outer arms, two visibly smaller chest arms, two powerful digitigrade legs and one full spear-tail.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige chitin, restrained rose-taupe translucency at crown margins and membranes, cool gray recesses, dark mouth cavity, ivory/silver teeth and moist highlights.
designDetails.surface: Layered crown plates, biomechanical ribs, tendon channels and segmented tail remain readable through value and material contrast. The albino surface is newly authored, never a white filter over base frames.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless royal head and crown, one ribbed torso, exactly four arms with an unambiguous large/small hierarchy, two digitigrade legs and one continuous tail. Mobile combat Queen: no ovipositor or egg sac.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 40 poses; crown, four hands, feet and full tail remain inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit the reviewed enemy-008 physical scale and rigid crown/thorax proportions. Never infer size from tail arc, crown angle, crouch height or a single extreme pose.
designDetails.root: Inherit the base reviewed pelvis/proximal-leg registration and supporting-foot floor. Crown, tail and changing arm reach never redefine the root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, hive resin, text or grid.
